permissions.claim_scope: F-free/TX-label-free paired source IQ training; F used only in separate source no-query preflight and frozen ground evaluation

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original DURA plus independently initialized 14966274-parameter attention/local cumulant-conditioned recovery model; final output projection initialized to zero
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed original source-only DURA; same 32768 legal L_s/U_s fit IDs; fresh views epochs01-30 use matching physical IDs and no F/TX/target in G training
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA; independently initialized matched cumulant model; F only in separate no-query preflight and frozen evaluation

execution.gpu_policy: GPU5; wait for this-task final prediction PID 2461493 to exit, then one this-task GPU worker, >=8192 MiB free and fewer than three total compute apps; preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner on source role or contract mismatch, nonfinite output, wrong checkpoint, target or F/TX leakage, output collision, failed source no-query smoke, or systemic technical failure; preserve other owners and artifacts.

metric_names: source normalized IQ and DURA guard loss
dimensions: 3 source views per epoch, 30 unique source caches

rows.method: Full-window 8-layer width384 attention with local path and bounded centered lagged C22/C31 statistics from received, anchor and innovation; source IQ + .02 DURA change + .1 matched-cumulant loss
rows.purpose: Train only on authorized source paired IQ; no F/TX/V/target input
rows.seed_notes: Model seed 2026110901; source fit 2026110611; training order 2026110902; evaluation 2026092701.
rows.scenario: source epochs01-30 rotated in 10 groups of 3, repeated twice
rows.budget_ref: 14966274 trainable + 266951 frozen DURA; 32768 source IDs x 3 views x 20 epochs, batch32, plus DURA context preparation

notes: Matched architecture, initialization, optimizer, 32768 fit IDs, 3 views/record/epoch and 20 epochs against fixed-view cumulant context; each of 30 pre-existing source views used twice. DURA source context preparation adds compute time.
Source paired IQ only, TX labels hidden and no F weights or outputs, V or target access in G training; F used only separate source no-query smoke and frozen evaluation.
Fixed final epoch20; every version completes clean and six practical predictions before independent truth-last; previously exposed ground test is not blind and not real satellite.
Same-record 3-view vs 30-view scene counts are source metadata only; increased coverage is not proof of performance.
